text.p: The directors of junior gold explorer Adelaide Resources NL said on Thursday the company's A$5 million initial public offering had closed over-subscribed.

Shares in Adelaide Resources, which has interests in the Tanami Gold Province in the Northern Territory and in South Austraia's Gawler Craton, are expected to commence trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on or around September 12, the company said in a statement.
The company had offered 20 million shares at 25 cents each.

The float, underwritten by McIntosh Corporate Ltd, had experienced strong retail demand from across the country from investors keen to gain exposure to the exploration potential of the regions, the company said.
Adelaide Resources has 15 exploration licences and 14 applications in the Tanami and Gawler regions and the Tennant Creek district in the NT, totalling 13,400 square kilometres.

Of the total area, 66 percent is held by Adelaide Resources in its own right, with the remainder in joint ventures with Aberfoyle Resources Ltd, Posgold Ltd, and Troy Resources NL, which have cumulative commitments of A$3.8 million to earn 51 percent equity, the company said.
